_comment: The settings the engine reads when it starts. Change a value, save, and run again - no rebuilding. config/engine.example.json is the documented copy; this is the one that is actually read.

logging._note: threshold hides anything less important than the level you name. Info, Warning or Error.

tunables._note: fixedTimestepSeconds is how much time one simulation step represents. 0.016666667 is sixty steps a second. Try 0.1 and watch the movement become chunky while the drawing stays smooth.

physics._note: gravity is in the units your game uses. Unity's -9.81 is metres per second squared; this project works in PIXELS, so -981 is the same real-world gravity at roughly 100 pixels to the metre. Set gravity to [0,0] for a top-down game. solverIterations is how many passes the contact solver makes - raise it if stacked objects sink into each other.

input._note: A binding is Device.Name. Key. followed by any key name, or Mouse. followed by Left, Right or Middle. An action can have several, which is how WASD and the arrow keys both work.
